t: Magnusson 18mm snap-off knife blades are suitable for precise cutting tasks across various trades. Manufactured from high quality carbon steel, the blades offer strength and maximum cutting power, making them ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders. Each blade is heat-treated and hardened for enhanced durability and lifespan. The convenient 10-pack ensures professionals always have sharp blades ready for use, and includes a safety dispenser to protect fingers during blade changes. Features 7 sections per blade to ensure a fresh, sharp edge is always available for efficient work on site or in the workshop.
